{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2015}}
{{main|2015 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''2015 World Table Tennis Championships men's doubles''' was the 53rd edition of the men's doubles championship.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.allabouttabletennis.com/world-table-tennis-championships-medal-winners.html|title=List of Winners|publisher=All About Table Tennis}}</ref>
<ref name=ITTF>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsMD.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120412045730/http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsMD.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-date=2012-04-12|title=2015 results|publisher=International Table Tennis Federation}}</ref>

[[Chen Chien-an]] and [[Chuang Chih-yuan]] were the defending champions, but chose not to participate this year.<ref>[http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_doubles_wttc_web.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=2503&Doubles=1 Entry list]</ref>

[[Xu Xin (table tennis)|Xu Xin]] and [[Zhang Jike]] won the title by defeating [[Fan Zhendong]] and [[Zhou Yu (table tennis)|Zhou Yu]] 12–14, 11–7, 11–9, 9–11, 11–7, 11–9 in the final.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=39531&Competition_ID=2503&|title=Xu Xin Adds to Title Hall, Partners Zhang Jike to Men's Doubles Gold|date=2 May 2015|work=ittf.com}}</ref>

==Seeds==
Matches were best of 5 games in qualification and best of 7 games in the 64-player sized main draw.<ref>[http://www.ittf.com//World_Events/wttc_2015/Playing%20system_WTTC2015.pdf Playing system]</ref><ref>[http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_doubles_wttc_web.asp?Gender=M&Tour_ID=2503&Seeded_Doubles=1&FormParticipants_Sorting=26&FormParticipants_Sorted=& Seeds]</ref>
